title: Binary search on the answer
learn: search over the answer range with a feasibility check (monotonic predicate)
hook: Koko Eating Bananas and Capacity to Ship Packages look nothing like binary search: there's no sorted array to search. Spotting that you can binary search the answer itself is one of the most satisfying "aha" moments in interview prep.

explain.prompt: Explain "binary search on the answer" using Koko Eating Bananas or Capacity to Ship Packages.
keyPoints: search over the possible answers (speeds, capacities), not over an array
a feasibility check tells whether a candidate works, usually one greedy O(n) pass
feasibility is monotonic: if X works, every larger X works → binary search for the smallest X that works
bounds come from the input (e.g. max(weights)..sum(weights))
